onboarding.documentTitle: Khokha kunoma iyiphi i-spaza ngenoma iyiphi iwalethi
onboarding.body: Thatha izinkokhelo nge-QR code kuphela. Awudingi umshini wamakhadi, isebenzisa idatha encane kakhulu, futhi iyaqhubeka isebenza noma isiginali ingekho.

empty.title: Izinkokhelo zizovulwa maduze
empty.description: Lesi sitolo sisalungiselela. Zama futhi emva kwesikhashana.

empty.title: Azikabikho izinkokhelo
empty.description: Izinkokhelo zivela lapha ngokushesha uma zingena, futhi ifoni yakho iyazifunda ngezwi.

empty.title: Awekho amathebhu avuliwe
empty.description: Vula ithebhu e-spaza yakho kanye nje, bese ukhokha ngokuthinta, ngisho noma isiginali ingekho.

offline.banner: Awuxhumekile ku-inthanethi. I-AnyPay iyaqhubeka isebenza futhi izovumelanisa uma usubuyile.
